insight: First UK company to meet the NHS DTAC compliance standard for clinical AI; seed round led by Khosla Ventures.
name: TORTUS
tagline: Ambient clinical AI co-pilot built and regulated with the NHS.
description: TORTUS is a clinical AI assistant for doctors that uses ambient voice to capture patient consultations and auto-generate structured notes, letters, referrals, and coding suggestions directly inside the electronic health record. Its O.S.L.E.R. system acts as an AI agent across documentation and admin tasks, while a proprietary 'Shell' safety layer detects and strips hallucinations before a clinician reviews the note. Built with the NHS, it is sold to health systems and GP practices rather than to individual clinicians.
edge: Pairs ambient scribing with a 'Shell' safety layer that removes ~93% of detected hallucinations, co-developed and regulated with the NHS.
pros: Built and regulated with the NHS
Goes beyond notes to orders and referrals
Writes structured data into the EHR
